intent: immediate type preview, undo and redo, palette selection; no animated text shaping

source.redistribution: The adapter fetches upstream files on demand; this package does not redistribute the upstream library.

review.purpose: Name the user-facing purpose before selecting a motion recipe.
review.statePair: unresolved -> inspect the actual resting and resulting states
review.trigger: Identify the real user or system trigger; do not animate on a decorative timer.
review.decision: No single recipe matched confidently; review the catalog before applying one.

steps: Do not invent a recipe; return to Review and name the state relationship first.

rules: Infer usage before choosing a token; never replace a value only because a number is nearby.
Make open states inviting and close states faster/quieter, except for symmetric swaps such as tabs and page side-by-side.
Keep stagger totals short, reserve delay for intent gating or sequencing, and never delay dismissal.
Use blur/scale/distance only when they explain a swap or spatial relationship; leave plain fades alone.

guardrails.motionPurpose: feedback / continuity / reveal / comparison / progress / inspection / narrative
guardrails.cleanup: Keep the local state cleanup explicit; do not leave closing or replay classes behind.
guardrails.reducedMotion: Keep the resting and final states readable without animation; use a static state for unsupported motion.
guardrails.fallback: The final state must remain understandable with animation removed, interrupted, or unsupported on the target device.

next: Run Review against the project and choose one recipe only after the state relationship is clear.
